summary: Iteration 2 fully verified end-to-end. All 15 new backend tests pass in ~29s covering: version=1.1.0, real SSE streaming (meta -> N tokens -> done), Mongo session persistence + list/get/delete, multi-turn context injection (LLM correctly recalled '4242' across two turns), Compare with 3 parallel real LLMs (GPT-5.2 + Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Gemini 3 Flash all OK), GPT-image-1 returned a real PNG (magic bytes verified, >1KB), Nano Banana auto-route also returned real image bytes. Frontend E2E via Playwright: streaming response-card grows live, streaming badge disappears at done, session appears in sidebar with turn_count+last_model, new-session-btn returns to empty-state, session click reloads history, compare-mode-toggle shows compare-model-picker + hides force-model-select, 3 compare-cell-{id} rendered with distinct Italian responses. Model Registry and Archive navigation still work. No regressions.

design_issues.screen: CompareCard (3-column layout at ~1920px in the app viewport)
issues: RouterPill in each compare cell wraps to 3 lines and 'CAP/LAT/COST' badges partially overlap the display_name text when 3 cells are shown side-by-side. Content is still readable but visual polish is off. Consider stacking pill metrics below display_name in narrow columns, or truncating display_name.

action_items: (Optional polish) Refine RouterPill layout inside CompareCell so metric badges don't overlap the display name when 3-4 columns are shown side-by-side.
critical_code_review_comments: services/history.py opens its own AsyncIOMotorClient at import time separate from server.py's client, resulting in two Mongo client instances against the same DB. Consolidate into a single client passed via dependency or module singleton to avoid connection pool duplication.

orchestrator._run_image_gen still swallows provider exceptions and returns '[Errore image gen: ...]' string, so the caller can't distinguish provider failure from a valid text-only result. Consider returning a structured error field so the frontend can render a retry/error UI.

orchestrate_stream persists via history.save_turn AFTER the done event is emitted, but the frontend refreshes the sessions panel on onDone. Because SSE consumer receives 'done' before the DB write completes, on very fast networks the sessions list refetch can occasionally miss the just-created turn (minor race). Persist BEFORE yielding done, or await the write in the same tick.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager.
OrchestrateRequest / CompareRequest do not cap prompt length or file size; unbounded payloads could hit the 60-180s LLM timeout with expensive calls. Add size guards.

Dashboard.jsx: session history is rehydrated by reversing the messages array (`rehydrated.reverse()`) — history is fetched sorted ASC by created_at, then reversed so latest-first, which is fine, but the intent is not obvious from code. Comment or use consistent ordering.
seed_data_creation: Tests create disposable Mongo sessions in ai4life_sessions and ai4life_messages collections; test_delete_session cleans up its own. Other sessions remain visible in sidebar (expected, not test pollution — real Mongo persistence).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (pytest, 15 tests, ~29s). Iteration 1 tests still valid at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (14/14). Run both together via `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. SSE tested via requests.iter_content stream parsing. Compare uses 3 default models: gpt-5.2, claude-sonnet-4.5, gemini-3-flash. Image tests hit real providers so budget ~60s. Multi-turn test asserts LLM literally recalls the number '4242' from prior turn — this is a real semantic check, not just DB inspection. Frontend flows verified via Playwright including streaming, compare 3-model, session load, new-session, nav.
